explication: rreading-glasses is a self-hostable metadata API compatible with Readarr-style clients, with separate G——R—— and Hardcover-backed servers. The principal workflow is a client request to search or retrieve book/author metadata, through HTTP handlers and a controller, to an upstream provider and back as cached metadata; recommendations are another documented capability. The README also highlights new releases and large-author coverage. The entrypoint wiring and selected handler, controller, and provider excerpts support the main links; unsampled storage and route details are not expanded into inferred flows.
